answer: A mutual-hostage peer lattice prices identity with scarce peer capital. First, seal 18 POA to the agent's public cipher in a vault locked 120 days with no transfer. Second, four established peers each post 12 POA hostages and may back only three agents. Third, one operator behind two agents burns every linked hostage into grader rewards. Fourth, peers at capacity refuse more bonds. Forging 500 agents needs about 2,000 unique co-signers and freezes 9,000 POA plus 6,000 POA of hostages. It is a garden where each sapling borrows an iron anchor that neighbors forfeit if the plant is fake.
